summary: Amsterdam, software developer, strong interest in open-source software, advocates for privacy and security in technology, critical of consumerism and environmental impact, supports de-Googled mobile operating systems, engaged in discussions about technology's role in society, emphasizes the importance of biodiversity and sustainability, skeptical of large tech companies and their practices, prefers using Linux and alternative operating systems, values community-driven projects, interested in drone technology and photogrammetry, actively participates in technical discussions on platforms like Reddit.
